cmd: git ls-files && echo --- && for f in $(git ls-files | grep '\.py$'); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done

mkdir -p invoices && printf '' > invoices/__init__.py && cat > invoices/total.py <<'EOF'
from payments.charge import charge


def invoice_total(amounts):
    """Return the invoice total in cents; amounts are dollars."""
    return sum(charge(amount) for amount in amounts)
EOF
cat > tests/test_invoices.py <<'EOF'
from invoices.total import invoice_total


def test_invoice_total():
    assert invoice_total([5, 10]) == 1500
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -n 15; git status --short
